newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony hits high for calendar year.
newsitem.headline: Sony hits high for calendar year.

text.p: Sony Corp shares hit a high for the calendar year in early Thursday morning trade as investors continued their quest for blue-chip issues, brokers said.
The shares rose to a high of 9,300 yen but had retraced to 9,280, up 40 yen, by 0040 GMT.
Morgan Stanley Japan Ltd analyst Takatoshi Yamamoto said that he saw Sony as a core issue for the electronics sector and that 10,000 yen was a goal for the share price.
Yamamoto added that the firm would benefit from the weakness of the yen against the dollar and that group earnings would likely be handsome.
